test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The angle subtended by a chord on the center of a circle is 180 degrees. What will be the angle subtended by the same chord on the circumference of this circle?
solution:
**Given:**

Angle subtended by a chord at the centre = 180°

**Concept Used:**

The angle subtended by a chord at the centre is twice the angle subtended on the circumference.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4794a8a3cb1d3b881154b7a8e9f13feb361a1d5a19267b3cd213ac8ffd66b39e.png] 

⇒ Angle subtended on the circumference = 180° / 2 = 90°

**Therefore, the angle subtended by the same chord on the circumference is 90°.**
